grammar_title: 长句中的语法复习(Review of Long / Complex Sentences):从句连接词 · 非谓语 · 并列/强调/倒装
source: 人教版2019选择性必修四 Unit 3 Review useful structures(长难句):先拆主干再判从句/非谓语/特殊结构。句子均为海洋探索主题的自然长句,每句一空,答案唯一(其余选项语法或逻辑上不成立)。

points.point: 长句中的从句连接词(定语/状语/名词性从句:which/where/when/that/because/although/so that 等)
points.overview: 在复合长句里先找主句,再看空格引导的从句:看先行词与从句缺失成分(主/宾/状)选关系词;看逻辑关系(原因/让步/目的)选状语连词;看名词性从句是否完整选 that/whether/what 等。

points.point: 长句中的非谓语动词(doing / done / to do 作定语/状语/宾补)
points.overview: 句中已有谓语,空格处的动词只能用非谓语:与逻辑主语主动/进行→doing;被动/完成→done;表目的/将来/在 too…/be said 等结构→to do。

points.point: 长句中的并列、强调与倒装(not only…but also;it is…that 强调;Only…倒装;neither/so 倒装)
points.overview: 并列连词连接对等成分;强调句 it is/was…that 去掉后仍是完整句;Only+状语 / 否定词置于句首引起部分倒装(助动词提前);so/neither + 倒装表'也(不)'。

questions.stem: The Jiaolong, ____ can dive seven kilometres deep, has helped Chinese scientists study the dark ocean floor.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句先行词 the Jiaolong 指物、从句缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: We must explore the oceans ____ cover most of our planet if we want to truly understand the earth.
questions.explanation: 先行词 oceans 指物、从句缺主语(cover 的主语)→ which/that,此处给 which。

questions.stem: In recent years China has joined several expeditions to the Arctic, ____ scientists study how the climate is changing.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the Arctic 表地点、从句不缺主宾(只缺地点状语)→ where。

questions.stem: I will never forget the moment ____ the manned submersible finally touched the deepest part of the sea.
questions.explanation: 先行词 moment 表时间、从句完整(只缺时间状语)→ when。

questions.stem: Although the ancient sea routes of Zheng He have been travelled many times, there are still places ____ no modern ship has reached.
questions.explanation: 先行词 places、从句缺宾语(reached 的宾语)→ that(或 which),此处给 that。

questions.stem: Scientists keep logging new species, ____ greatly improves our understanding of life in the deep sea.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指代整个前一句、作从句主语 → which。

questions.stem: ____ the ice is melting faster now, ships can look for more fossil fuels further north in the Arctic.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系(冰融化得快→船能往北找燃料)→ Because。

questions.stem: ____ whaling was banned in 1982, some countries are still hunting these intelligent creatures without mercy.
questions.explanation: 前后让步转折(虽被禁,仍有人捕猎)→ Although。

questions.stem: We need to understand exactly ____ is happening to our oceans so that we can take real action in time.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺主语、表'什么'→ what。

questions.stem: Researchers took photos of each whale's fins ____ they could identify the animals on future trips.
questions.explanation: 表目的(为了日后能辨认)→ so that。

questions.stem: The research vessel Kexue, ____ home port is in Qingdao, can carry out a wide range of marine tasks.
questions.explanation: 定语从句表所属(船的母港)→ whose。

questions.stem: This is the very database ____ the researchers store the photos and locations of every group of whales.
questions.explanation: 先行词 database 视作抽象地点、从句完整 → where(= in which)。

questions.stem: It still remains to be seen ____ the tiny capsule can really work under such crushing pressure.
questions.explanation: 主语从句表'是否'、句意不确定 → whether。

questions.stem: Hundreds of years ago, merchants set sail across the sea ____ they could trade silk and tea for precious spices.
questions.explanation: 表目的(为了换香料)→ so that。

questions.stem: The Deepwater Horizon disaster, ____ spilled millions of gallons of oil, killed countless sea birds and fish.
questions.explanation: 非限制性定语从句指物、缺主语 → which。

questions.stem: 1405 was the year ____ Zheng He first led his huge fleet out onto the open sea.
questions.explanation: 先行词 year 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: No one yet knows ____ lies in the deepest parts of the ocean, because we have explored less than five percent of it.
questions.explanation: 宾语从句缺主语、表'什么'→ what。

questions.stem: The sea is home to life, not a possession ____ human beings may use up however they like.
questions.explanation: 先行词 possession、从句缺宾语(use up 的宾语)→ that(或 which)。

questions.stem: ____ technology improves, we may have more options for keeping a balance between protection and exploitation.
questions.explanation: 表'随着'(技术进步,选择变多)→ As。

questions.stem: Opponents may be worried, but sea exploration matters so much ____ it can help us face climate change.
questions.explanation: so + adj./adv. + that 结果状语从句 → that。

questions.stem: ____ after a mythical dragon, the manned submersible Jiaolong carried Chinese scientists into the deep sea.
questions.explanation: submersible 与 name 是被动关系(被命名)、作状语 → 过去分词 Named。

questions.stem: The research ship Kexue is designed ____ a wide range of difficult tasks far out at sea.
questions.explanation: be designed to do 表用途/目的 → 不定式 to conduct。

questions.stem: New technology makes it possible ____ the deepest spots of the ocean that no diver could ever reach.
questions.explanation: make it possible to do,it 为形式宾语 → to explore。

questions.stem: The ship struggled on through the storm, ____ wildly with each huge wave that hit its side.
questions.explanation: ship 与 roll 主动、表伴随 → 现在分词 rolling 作状语。

questions.stem: Plastic pollution, ____ in our tap water in recent years, has become a serious danger to marine life.
questions.explanation: pollution 与 find 被动 → 过去分词 found 作后置定语。

questions.stem: Young people came to the camp ____ more about whales and other amazing sea creatures.
questions.explanation: 表目的状语 → 不定式 to learn。

questions.stem: The deep ocean is too dark and too cold ____ without special equipment and powerful lights.
questions.explanation: too…to do 结构 → to explore。

questions.stem: Standing on the deck, the campers watched the whales ____ slowly out of the cold blue water.
questions.explanation: watch sb doing 表正在进行 → 现在分词 leaping 作宾补。

questions.stem: The Jiaolong submersible is said ____ able to reach a depth of seven kilometres below the surface.
questions.explanation: be said to do/be 表传闻 → to be。

questions.stem: China has invested billions in systems and services along these routes, ____ the whole area develop for future trade.
questions.explanation: 与前句主动、表结果伴随 → 现在分词 helping。

questions.stem: ____ the most advanced research vessel in the country, Kexue draws the attention of scientists worldwide.
questions.explanation: vessel 与 regard 被动(被视为)→ 过去分词 Regarded as 作状语。

questions.stem: There is an urgent need ____ the Arctic in order to understand climate change and its effects.
questions.explanation: need 后接不定式作定语 → to study。

questions.stem: We saw a database ____ to store the photos and locations of every whale the team had followed.
questions.explanation: database 与 build 被动 → 过去分词 built 作后置定语。

questions.stem: The young sailor read books all day on the boat, ____ his family every evening using a small laptop.
questions.explanation: 与主句主动、表伴随 → 现在分词 emailing。

questions.stem: Accessing the deep ocean may also help scientists ____ events such as earthquakes long before they happen.
questions.explanation: help (sb) (to) do,空后接原形 → predict。

questions.stem: ____ for two years, the old sea routes were finally reopened to merchant ships from many nations.
questions.explanation: routes 与 close 被动、表完成 → 过去分词 Closed 作状语。

questions.stem: The camp gives students a real chance ____ whale songs and watch these huge animals at close range.
questions.explanation: chance to do 不定式作定语 → to hear。

questions.stem: With the latest technology in hand, China keeps reaching out across the sea, ____ stronger bonds with the world.
questions.explanation: 与主句主动、表伴随结果 → 现在分词 building。

questions.stem: It is not rare ____ the most unique flowers and plants dancing in the fast-moving water of the deep.
questions.explanation: It is + adj. + to do,it 为形式主语 → to see。

questions.stem: The mother of the Sea King, ____ proud to be born into the royal family, takes care of his six daughters.
questions.explanation: 与逻辑主语主动、表状态 → 现在分词 feeling 作状语。

questions.stem: Sea exploration not only helps us find new medicines ____ also leads us to new sources of food and energy.
questions.explanation: not only … but also 固定并列结构 → but。

questions.stem: It was the writing of the ships' logs ____ allowed later sailors to follow the very same routes safely.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It was … that 强调主语 the writing → that。

questions.stem: Only after the storm finally passed ____ the exhausted sailor able to see the distant shore.
questions.explanation: Only + 状语置句首引起部分倒装,主句用 was the sailor able → was。

questions.stem: We can explore the sea to learn from it, ____ we can exploit it carelessly until nothing is left.
questions.explanation: 两种相反选择(学习它 / 或耗尽它)→ or。

questions.stem: The ocean is huge, ____ it is far more sensitive than most people are willing to believe.
questions.explanation: 前后转折(很大,然而脆弱)→ yet。

questions.stem: It is climate change ____ this melting Arctic ice is warning us about so clearly and so urgently.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It is … that 强调宾语 climate change → that。

questions.stem: Not until we protect the deep sea today ____ future generations forgive us for our choices.
questions.explanation: Not until 置句首引起部分倒装,主句将来时 → will。

questions.stem: Mining damages the ocean floor, and ____ does overfishing harm the balance of marine life.
questions.explanation: 前句肯定、后句'也'(同样有害)→ so + 倒装。

questions.stem: Scientists must study the deep sea, ____ they cannot manage the planet's resources wisely.
questions.explanation: '否则'(不研究就无法管好资源)→ or。

questions.stem: It was in 2010 ____ the Deepwater Horizon spilled over two hundred million gallons of oil into the sea.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It was … that 强调时间状语 in 2010 → that(非 when)。

questions.stem: The sailor did not give up his dream, ____ did the heavy storms ever break his quiet courage.
questions.explanation: 前句否定、后句'也不'→ nor + 倒装。

questions.stem: Sea exploration brings real risks, ____ these should be carefully balanced against our economic needs.
questions.explanation: 前后转折(有风险,但应权衡)→ but。

questions.stem: Rarely ____ the public realise just how little of the vast deep ocean we have actually explored.
questions.explanation: 否定副词 Rarely 置句首引起部分倒装,主语 the public 视作单数 → does。

questions.stem: It is the writing system of ships' charts ____ has guided fleets safely across the open sea for centuries.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It is … that 强调主语 → that。

questions.stem: The deep sea may hide not only valuable minerals ____ also new sources of clean energy for the future.
questions.explanation: not only … but also → but。

questions.stem: Whales are hunted for their meat, ____ are dolphins killed for so-called scientific research.
questions.explanation: 前句肯定、'海豚也(被捕)'→ so + 倒装(so are dolphins killed)。

questions.stem: Only then ____ the campers fully understand why protecting sea creatures truly matters.
questions.explanation: Only then 置句首引起部分倒装,过去语境 → did。

questions.stem: We may imagine there is nothing under the sea but sand, ____ the deep is in fact full of life.
questions.explanation: 前后转折(以为只有沙,然而满是生命)→ yet。

questions.stem: It was courage and passion ____ made the young sailor's dream of crossing the ocean come true.
questions.explanation: 强调句 It was … that 强调主语 → that。

questions.stem: Sailing alone around the world is a mixture of danger and boredom, ____ few people are brave enough to try it.
questions.explanation: 因果(因此很少人敢尝试)→ so。
